sections.title: Container and waybill management menu
sections.content:
![](/uploads/3047a143be39d2490da62bb5.png)

- **Waybills:** this menu contains every container and waybill of every order.

- **Waybill documents:** this menu contains every document of the waybills.

sections.title: Creating the containers and waybills for a booking
sections.content:
## Creating waybills

### Step 1

Open the booking — it has to be confirmed — → click **CREATE WAYBILL**.

![](/uploads/9d76d57ca85e7047f60675f8.png)

The system uses the number of containers in the booking's order size table and creates the matching waybills automatically:

![](/uploads/d590d2695f6cecb965c9087f.png)

### Step 2

The system returns the list of containers and waybills it has just created.

![](/uploads/577b5c123f85b95b2510bea0.png)

![](/uploads/2b76fb80fe3da998acd32292.png)

- Every container and waybill created is in the **NEW** state.

- These containers and waybills are still missing data, so they are highlighted in red. Once all the required fields are filled in, the red highlight goes away.

sections.title: Filling in each container and waybill
sections.content:
## Ways to fill in waybill information - Option 1: fill in each waybill one at a time. - Option 2: use "Mass Edit" to update many waybills at once. ## Option 1: one waybill at a time - **Step 1:** open each waybill and enter the order and waybill information: ![](/uploads/bc1cf59a7e9a43b36eb85064.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Container number |Enter the container number for the "Import a full container" and "Move a laden container domestically" order types.
For the "Export a full container" order type, the driver enters the container number in the mobile app and the system synchronises it back to TMS. The dispatcher can also enter it for them. | | Waybill code | Leave this empty; the system generates it. | | Customer | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Booking/Order | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Booking code | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Order type | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Booking note | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. You can change it. | | Planned date | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. You can change it. | | Container size | Leave this empty; the system selects it when the waybill is created from the order. You can change it. | | Container type | Enter or search for the container type in the list. | | Seal number | Enter the seal number for the "Import a full container" order type. For "Export a full container", the driver enters it in the mobile app and the data is synchronised back to TMS. | | Container pickup code | Enter the pickup code as a note for the driver collecting the container. | | Container pickup place | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Stuffing/unstuffing place | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Container drop-off place | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. | | Container delivery date | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. You can update it. | | DEM / CY Cutoff date| The system shows either DEM or CY Cutoff depending on the order type.
Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. You can update it. | | DET / SI Cutoff date | The system shows either DET or SI Cutoff depending on the order type.
Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order. You can update it. | | Planned driver | Select or search for the driver assigned to carry this container. | | Planned vehicle | Select or search for the vehicle assigned to carry this container. | | Planned trailer | Select or search for the trailer assigned to carry this container. | | Carrier | Select or search for the carrier in charge, if a third party is carrying it for you. | | Note for the carrier | Enter a note for the carrier taking the waybill — for example the PIN for collecting the laden container. | - **Step 2:** enter the waybill notes: ![](/uploads/a67a06c6dc009a44edbb8707.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Customer note | Enter the customer's note for the container, if any. | | Waybill note | Enter a note for the container or waybill, if any. | | Note for the driver | Enter a note for the driver, if any — for example container requirements or the pickup time. | | Freight note | Enter a note from the freight team about additional costs or other matters, if any. | - **Step 3:** enter the cargo and customs declaration information: ![](/uploads/5deca29088c1f7602f950201.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Cargo | Select the type of cargo. | | Packaging | Select the packaging specification for the cargo. | | VGM | Enter the VGM. | | Declaration number | Enter the customs declaration number. | | Customs channel | Select the customs channel. | | Customs cleared | Tick this once customs has been cleared. | - **Step 4:** enter the port and container transfer information, if any: ![](/uploads/b12edf325a04f64e80d319f3.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Port of loading | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order for reference. | | Transshipment port | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order for reference. | | Port of destination | Leave this empty; the system takes it from the order for reference. | | Container transfer option | The system takes the default from the order, but you can adjust it for each container and waybill. | | Container transfer status | Three values: Not started (the default), In progress, Completed. While the container is being transferred between ports, you can update this to keep track. | | Container transfer note | Enter a note about the transfer, if any. | - **Step 5:** fill in the tasks of the waybill. This task table is created from the template task table on the order. ![](/uploads/71ecc6b215a9f66242b0aef8.png) - On the task table of each waybill you can: - Click "Add a line" to add a task. - Click the "Bin" icon at the end of a row to delete that task. - Click any row to see the details of that task. - Click the icon and drag to reorder the tasks. - Enter the task information: | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Task code | The system generates this. Leave it empty. | | Task | Name of the task. | | Task status | How far along the task is. It changes as the driver works or the dispatcher updates it. | | Location | Where the task is carried out. | | Contact | The contact at that location. | | Mobile | The contact's phone number. | | Note for the driver | A note for the driver, if any. It is shown in the mobile app. | | Planned date | Enter the date you plan the driver to carry out the task. The dispatcher sets a date that makes dispatching work well. | | Deadline | Enter the deadline from the paperwork, or one the dispatcher sets to keep track of the task. | | Plan | The container plan at the customer's warehouse. Applies to tasks such as "Deliver laden container" or "Drop off empty container" at a customer warehouse. The values are: drop container, detach trailer, store vehicle. This is also shown in the mobile app so the driver knows the plan.
Whether this field appears depends on the configuration.| ![](/uploads/58cdf53027786b08567e4826.png) - **Step 6:** click **SAVE**, or press **CTRL + S**, to save.

sections.title: Using \"Mass Edit\" to update many at once
sections.content:
## Ways to fill in waybill information

- Option 1: fill in each waybill one at a time.

- Option 2: use "Mass Edit" to update many waybills at once.

## Option 2: Mass Edit — updating many at once

### Step 1
On the container and waybill list, tick the waybills you want to update in bulk (1) → click Actions (2) → click the "Mass Edit" entry for that order type (3).

![](/uploads/43e2eb82595031449c643034.png)

### Step 2

The system shows the popup below. Enter values for the fields you want to change:

  1. Fields to change: choose Set and enter the value next to it.

  2. Fields to leave alone: leave them on Don't touch.

![](/uploads/a16ad2d04954972084702e4d.png)

### Step 3

Click **APPLY** on the popup to update them all.

## Note

The system only lets you select waybills that belong to the same order for a bulk update.

sections.title: Quickly filling in container and seal numbers
sections.content:
For an "Export a full container" waybill, the driver enters the container and seal numbers in the mobile app when they complete the "Pick up empty container" task, and both are synchronised from the mobile app to Odoo.

For an "Import a full container" waybill, the dispatcher has to fill both in after the waybill is created. Here is how to do that quickly from the waybill list, without opening each waybill:

### Step 1

On the container and waybill list, tick the waybills whose container and seal numbers you want to update (1) → click Actions (2) → click the "Enter container & seal numbers in bulk" entry for that order type (3).

![](/uploads/43e2eb82595031449c643034.png)

### Step 2

The system shows the popup below. Click each "Container number" and "Seal number" cell of each waybill to fill it in.

![](/uploads/873cdce92306b43eaaff39e8.png)

### Step 3

Click Save to store the container and seal numbers you entered.

sections.title: Confirming a container or waybill
sections.content:
## Ways to confirm a container or waybill

- **Option 1:** confirm one specific container or waybill.

- **Option 2:** confirm many containers or waybills at once.

## Option 1:

**Confirming one specific container or waybill**

### Step 1
On the details screen of a waybill → click **CONFIRM**. When you confirm, the system checks whether the waybill has all the information it needs. If the system warns you, complete the missing information and confirm again.

![](/uploads/79d7299d9bc73f77168522c4.png)

### Step 2:
A successfully confirmed waybill shows the message below. Click **CLOSE**, or press **ESC**, to dismiss it. The waybill then moves to the **CONFIRMED** state.

![](/uploads/d09765b4505251965fde0c6d.png)

![](/uploads/d66cfcfc1f7cefad2415db26.png)

## Option 2:

**Confirming many containers or waybills at once**

### Step 1
Open the container and waybill list → tick the containers and waybills you want to confirm.

![](/uploads/9124280153a5ede5c9d91ded.png)

### Step 2
Click **CONFIRM**. When you confirm, the system checks whether each waybill has all the information it needs. If the system warns you, complete the missing information and confirm again.

![](/uploads/32e4a5dc958d0a5a2596babf.png)

### Step 3
A successfully confirmed waybill shows the message below. Click **CLOSE**, or press **ESC**, to dismiss it. The waybill then moves to the **CONFIRMED** state.

![](/uploads/3de7226f06224ae8364fd52d.png)

sections.title: Creating a dispatch order for a container or waybill
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Open the waybill list → tick the waybill you want to dispatch → click **DISPATCH**.

![](/uploads/528a01aa822ca4bd51fc929c.png)

**Note:**

One dispatch order can take either one 40ft waybill, or one 20ft waybill, or two 20ft waybills as a container pair.

### Step 2

The system shows the dispatch planning screen as below.

![](/uploads/67a828ef7ccbad16083fcf9b.png)

The image below shows the waybills selected for dispatch planning.

- You can choose the dispatch date in the **"Dispatch date"** box to assign the orders to the same day.

- The list shows a summary for each container — order details, locations, container number and so on — so the dispatcher can plan properly.

- Click the **"X"** on a row to remove that container or waybill from the plan.

- Click **"Add a line"** to open the waybill search popup and add another waybill to the plan.

![](/uploads/c7ed27088119b63c6a0a5b5d.png)

Fill in each row of the plan to assign a driver and a vehicle to the waybill:

  - **Planned driver**: select the driver being assigned.

  - **Planned vehicle**: when you select the driver, the system fills in that driver's default vehicle. You can still choose another one.

  - **Planned trailer**: when you select the driver, the system fills in the default trailer for that driver's vehicle. You can still choose another one.

  - **Planned date**: the system takes it from the planned date of the selected waybills. You can change it.

  - **Container number:** the system takes it from the container number of the selected waybills. You can change it.

  - **Container size:** the system takes it from the container size of the selected waybills. You can change it.

![](/uploads/5c6702d83b88d8359d2dad75.png)

### Step 3

Once everything is filled in, click **CREATE AND SEND TO DRIVER**.

- The system creates a new dispatch order and sends it to the driver.

![](/uploads/b79c64081cb2ec4c846d71b5.png)

sections.title: Canceling a container or waybill
sections.content:
## Note
You can only cancel a container or waybill while it is not complete.

There are two kinds of cancellation:

- Cancelled internally

- Cancelled by the customer.

## Canceling a container or waybill

### Step 1

Open the waybill you want to cancel → click **CANCEL**.

![](/uploads/abcf1b4275d4efef564b8f10.png)

### Step 2

The system asks "Are you sure you want to cancel the waybill?" → if you are, click **OK**.

![](/uploads/4229012b552a4292c836e0b0.png)

### Step 3

The system shows the cancellation popup as below → select the cancellation type and enter the reason → click **OK**.

- Read the notes highlighted in red before you confirm the cancellation.

![](/uploads/9494a5d40165ff73aef99fd7.png)

### Step 4

The system changes the state of the waybill.

- For cancellation type = Cancelled internally: the system moves the waybill to **CANCELED**.

![](/uploads/c837bf70ea273aadeb9ecf22.png)

- For cancellation type = Cancelled by the customer: the system moves the waybill to **NOT COMPLETED**.

![](/uploads/40dd86323169a3f5178705c4.png)

- Keeping the two kinds of cancellation in separate states makes it easy to tell them apart when charging the customer, if that applies.

sections.title: Deleting a container or waybill
sections.content:
## Note
You can only delete a waybill while it is **NEW** or **CANCELED**.

## Deleting a waybill

### Step 1

Open the waybill you want to delete, or open the waybill list and tick the waybills you want to delete → click the action icon (the cog) → click the delete action, as below.

![](/uploads/c1f102a9838b4b21b7bbb823.png)

### Step 2

The system asks you to confirm that you want to delete the data. If you are sure, click OK.

![](/uploads/dedcf12b54be15de7220ed9c.png)

sections.title: The states of a container or waybill
sections.content:
**A container or waybill has the following states:**

1. **New:** the waybill has just been created.

2. **Confirmed:** the waybill has been confirmed successfully.

3. **Assigned:** the waybill has been assigned to a dispatch order. As soon as any one task of the waybill is dispatched, the waybill moves to assigned.

4. **In progress:** any one task of the waybill has been started.

5. **Completed:** every task of the waybill is complete.

6. **Not completed:** the waybill was cancelled with the type "cancelled by the customer".

6. **Canceled:** the waybill was cancelled with the type "cancelled internally", or every task of the waybill was cancelled.

sections.title: Viewing the planned date
sections.content:
By default the system sorts containers and waybills by planned date, newest first.

- **The "Planned start" column:** the system takes the planned date of the first task in that waybill.

- **The "Planned end" column:** the system takes the planned date of the last task in that waybill.

- **The Timeline columns:** the system collects the important dates of the waybill in these columns.

![](/uploads/f17ba85bdccca7d1dc52afb4.png)

If you need specific date columns for sorting or for a closer look, click the icon at the end of the header and turn on the fields you want:

![](/uploads/3662082edcf812686a20beaf.png)

sections.title: The overdue status
sections.content:
## The overdue statuses of a container or waybill

1. **Overdue:** past the deadline.

2. **Due soon:** within 6 hours of the deadline.

3. **Normal:** more than 6 hours before the deadline.

## How the system works out whether a container or waybill is overdue

1. **An "Overdue" waybill:** when one of its tasks is "Overdue" and that task is not complete.

2. **A "Due soon" waybill:** when one of its tasks is "Due soon" and that task is not complete.

3. **A "Normal" waybill:** when every task of the waybill is "Normal".

## Viewing the overdue status

### In the container and waybill list

The system shows a light column so you can tell the overdue status of a waybill at a glance.

- **Overdue:** red light

- **Due soon:** yellow light

- **Normal:** green light

![](/uploads/14d5e853cd52fb18d2fc74d9.png)

### On the details screen of a container or waybill

When a waybill is "Due soon" or "Overdue", the system shows a matching ribbon as below.

![](/uploads/d64d7f2cb5b5f07ec01f9bf1.png)

The system also provides the "Overdue" and "Due soon" filters and a grouping by "Overdue status" so you can filter the data easily:

![](/uploads/677b561639e5c527220360d6.png)

sections.title: The dispatch status
sections.content:
## Dispatch status in the waybill list In the waybill list you can follow the dispatch status of the waybills through the information shown below: ![](/uploads/6753d91c8164dbd01e670129.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Task progress | Shown as X / Y:
- X is the number of tasks completed.
- Y is the total number of tasks to carry out. | | Paired waybill | The 20ft container waybill it is paired with. | | Dispatch order code | The list of dispatch orders for that waybill. If there are several, each one is a separate row. | | Dispatch order status | The state of the matching dispatch order. | | Carrier | If the dispatch order is carried by a cooperative vehicle, it is shown here; otherwise three dashes - - - appear. | | Vehicle | The licence plate for that dispatch order. If no vehicle has been assigned — the vehicle field is empty — three dashes - - - appear. | | Driver | The driver's name for that dispatch order. If no driver has been assigned — the driver field is empty — three dashes - - - appear. | | Trailer | The trailer's plate. If the waybill's task in that dispatch order has no trailer assigned — the trailer field is empty — three dashes - - - appear. | ## Searching by dispatch status You can search containers and waybills by any of these fields: ![](/uploads/ebba31523f900b7b7ea0673e.png) ## A few search tips - Type "---" and search by carrier to list the waybills carried by your own vehicles. - Type "---" and search by vehicle or driver to list the waybills that have a dispatch order but no vehicle or driver assigned to it yet.

sections.title: Filtering those that still need a vehicle
sections.content:
The system provides the "Needs dispatch" filter: it lists the waybills that are confirmed but have no dispatch order yet, or have no dispatch order for all of their tasks.

![](/uploads/8d9beedbcd50e9ffbd7285d2.png)
